chapter: Los Angeles scene, Tatum and Billy Berg's
title: Recording in a French castle studio near Paris with Slam Stewart and Jo Jones
summary: He made records near Paris with Slam Stewart and Jo Jones, and worked with Johnny Otis and Art Tatum.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Did ya ever record with them?

No, I never did. I made some...made some numbers over at...over in Paris with Slam Stewart, Jo Jones, Teddy Butler an' somebody else...I don't remember the name. We played over there. We made some records over in Europe...over in Paris there...somewhere in France. I don't know where we were. We were way out in...in the woods where some castle was. There was a big, ol' house looked like a castle. A man had a big studio over there, an' we played there for a long time. So now we gettin' up to time now. And we worked with Johnny Otis, Jo Jones an' all these people and the Sorrelles (?). We went to ...oh, let me see...we went to Hollywood and played with Art...with Art LaBoe's. We played with...uh, Art Tatum. Years ago, I made some records
